front.title: Read historical manuscripts page by page
front.intro: Manuscript AI keeps your scanned historical documents in one place, so you can browse their pages and, soon, transcribe them automatically. The site is under development
front.footer: A group project for the Advanced Software Engineering course at the University of Fribourg, autumn 2026.

preview.alt: Illuminated manuscript page from 1464, with one line of text and a cannon drawn in the margin outlined
preview.caption: Deeds of Sir Gillion de Trazegnies, southern Netherlands, 1464. Public domain.

upload.title: Add a document
upload.text: Upload the scanned pages of a document as a ZIP file of images.

read.title: Browse its pages
read.text: Open the document and move through its pages in a viewer built for reading scans.

transcribe.title: Transcribe a page
transcribe.text: Turn the handwriting on a page into text with a machine learning model.
